decision_rule: Only unresolved authority decisions are listed. No proposed engineering value is supplied.

decisions.decision_required: Release one current executable joint ontology/crosswalk between the four V7 joint families and the six SR11 records.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: SR11 is MODEL_SPECIFICATION_ONLY/CANDIDATE_SOURCE; V7 is metadata-only with executable_joint_graph=false. No controlled crosswalk exists.
decisions.downstream_effect: Joint graph and global DOF cannot be instantiated deterministically.

decisions.decision_required: Release the canonical current G2 body decomposition grain.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: 16 V7 reference/BOM records, 31 logical SR11 MBD groups, and 62 solids are different representation grains; no current physical rigid-body authority is released.

decisions.decision_required: Release machine-readable current frame/origin transforms and exact local joint axes.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: Only global +X/+Y/+Z convention is explicit. Current G2 frames list is empty and local physical axes are not uniformly released.
decisions.downstream_effect: Constraint equations cannot be created without reinterpretation.

decisions.decision_required: Release the executable initial state for the authorized G2 scenario.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: Current G2 status is BLOCKED and vehicle pulse/initial velocity is external-data-required; no numerical initial state is controlled.

decisions.decision_required: Release the G2 execution protocol values and acceptance tolerances.
decisions.why_evidence_insufficient: Only the generic CasADi software probe is qualified; no T-OCS execution protocol is authoritative.
decisions.downstream_effect: A later run could not be audited against a fixed protocol.
